# One-Month AWS Cloud Practitioner Study Plan

A focused 4-week plan built for a full-time schedule: short weekday sessions, longer Saturday review, and Sundays off. The goal is to build core AWS knowledge steadily and reach **80%+** on practice tests by the end of the month.

## 4-Week Study Roadmap

| Week | Dates | Focus | Key Sessions | Goal / Quiz |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Days 1-7 | AWS basics and cloud concepts | Weekdays: cloud benefits, shared responsibility, AWS global infrastructure; Saturday: review notes + glossary | 15-question quiz; target 60%+ |
| 2 | Days 8-14 | Core AWS services | Weekdays: compute, storage, database, networking; Saturday: service matching drill + recap | 20-question quiz; target 70%+ |
| 3 | Days 15-21 | Security, pricing, and support | Weekdays: IAM, security tools, pricing models, billing, support plans; Saturday: mixed review | 25-question quiz; target 75%+ |
| 4 | Days 22-30 | Exam readiness and practice tests | Weekdays: weak areas, exam-style questions, flashcards; Saturday: full practice test + review | Full practice test; target 80%+ |

## Weekly Study Plan

### Week 1: Cloud Foundations
- **Mon:** Cloud computing basics; why organizations use AWS
- **Tue:** Shared responsibility model
- **Wed:** AWS global infrastructure: Regions, Availability Zones, edge locations
- **Thu:** Basic AWS service categories overview
- **Fri:** Review all notes; make a 1-page cheat sheet
- **Sat:** 2-hour recap, flashcards, and 15-question quiz
- **Sun:** Off

### Week 2: Core AWS Services
- **Mon:** EC2, Lambda, Elastic Beanstalk
- **Tue:** S3, EBS, EFS, Glacier
- **Wed:** RDS, DynamoDB, Redshift basics
- **Thu:** VPC, Route 53, CloudFront, load balancing basics
- **Fri:** Review service use cases
- **Sat:** Match services to scenarios; 20-question quiz
- **Sun:** Off

### Week 3: Security, Pricing, and Support
- **Mon:** IAM users, groups, roles, MFA
- **Tue:** Security services: KMS, CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty
- **Wed:** Pricing basics: pay-as-you-go, reserved vs on-demand concepts
- **Thu:** Billing tools, AWS Budgets, Cost Explorer, support plans
- **Fri:** Review all security and pricing terms
- **Sat:** Mixed review set; 25-question quiz
- **Sun:** Off

### Week 4: Exam Practice and Weak Spots
- **Mon:** Review low-score topics from prior quizzes
- **Tue:** Scenario questions on core services
- **Wed:** Scenario questions on security and billing
- **Thu:** Flashcards and quick recall drill
- **Fri:** Light review; rest before practice test
- **Sat:** Full practice test under timed conditions; review every missed question
- **Sun:** Off

## Simple Progress Check Method

- **After each weekday session:** write 3 bullet points from memory.
- **Every Saturday:** take a timed quiz and record the score.
- **Score targets by week:** 60% → 70% → 75% → 80%+.
- **If you miss a target:** spend the next Friday on only weak topics before the Saturday quiz.
- **Final readiness rule:** move to the real exam only after one full practice test at **80% or higher**.
